rootCauseTraced.claim: P-175's crosswalk fix (LDT #668) only ever affected which TxGIO ring a gate-blocked node draws (parcelJoin.row in nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts), never the CAD-account attribute lookup that feeds baseFacts.situsAddress, cadRoll dollars, structural facts, legal description and exemption codes -- that lookup was, and until this fix remained, `cadPropertyRoll.byPropId.get(propId)` keyed by the ATOM'S OWN bare TxGIO prop_id, at three call sites in the CLI (the situs-key recovery prepass, the per-atom rollEntry, and buildConformantTier1Payload's own internal apn-keyed lookup in nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts:1252) plus a fourth read-only use for basis text (line ~1173 of the same builder file).
rootCauseTraced.verifiedBy: direct code read, all four call sites traced by line number, cross-checked against the overseer review's live observation (97658's ring, acreage and neighbours byte-identical before/after the P-175 publish; its label and dollars still Mesa Verde's own)
rootCauseTraced.whyThisExplainsTheOverseerFinding: for Hays, a TxGIO node's bare prop_id (e.g. 97658) can coincidentally equal a real, DIFFERENT CAD PropertyID (Mesa Verde's own account). cadPropertyRoll.byPropId.get('97658') therefore returns Mesa Verde's own row every time, regardless of what the geometry crosswalk resolved for the RING -- the two mechanisms never touched each other.

fixDesign.approach: a single new precompute block in the CLI, before the per-atom loop: effectiveCadPropertyRoll, identical object reference to cadPropertyRoll for a non-blocked county (strict no-op, zero behaviour change on Bastrop/Caldwell/McLennan/Travis), or a REMAPPED Map for a gate-blocked county -- still keyed by each atom's own bare prop_id (so every existing .byPropId.get(propId) call site downstream works unmodified, including the builder's own internal lookup), but each key now points at the entry for the CAD account the node's OWN geo_id names via the crosswalk.
fixDesign.newPureFunction: accountCrosswalkForNode (joinNormalize.ts) -- the REVERSE direction of the existing parcelCrosswalkJoinKey/crosswalkBindCorroborated (which answer 'which geometry does this account's geo_id name'; this answers 'which account does this node's own geo_id name'). Inputs: the node's own bare prop_id, its own geo_id (fetched via the existing fetchParcelRowsByPropIds/joinParcelRows helper, now also run for gate-blocked counties), and the SAME geoIdToAccountPropId / accountStemByPropId maps the existing geometry crosswalk already builds (inverted/reused, zero new queries beyond the one prop_id-keyed txgio_parcel fetch). Three outcomes, each counted: crosswalk (bound + corroborated or corroborator silent), no-crosswalk-account (node's geo_id resolves no account -- honest absence), corroboration-refused (resolved account's own QuickRefID stem names a DIFFERENT node -- positive evidence, refused not guessed).
fixDesign.resolverRevert: txgioAddressResolve.ts's situsNodeId/loadSitusCrosswalk (P-175's resolver-side crosswalk) deleted entirely. A parcel-situs hit for every county, gate-blocked or not, mints plain parcelNodeId(fips, propId) again. Containment (#668/#669's other half) untouched -- it was never crosswalked.
